scenarios.name: real_extension_native_consent_revocation
scenarios.title: Honor real Chrome native debugger cancellation across reconnect and worker restart
scenarios.workflow: Open owned page -> activate its native window -> click Chrome Cancel banner through X11 -> observe canceled_by_user -> refuse same Tab and fresh CLI input -> reconnect -> restart worker -> keep revocation
scenarios.user_problem: A user's explicit cancellation must never be undone by automatic recovery or implicit page creation.
